correctness.rationale: The normalized ellipse area moment matrix G is positive definite and exact scaling z=tw gives G(t)=t^2 D_t G D_t; its determinant exponent is 2(N+1)+2 sum_{j=0}^N j. On kth exterior power the unique least t-exponent minor I=J={0,...,k-1} survives as a positive rank-one limit and has nonzero eigenvalue det(G_k)det((G^-1)_k). Taking consecutive exterior-power products establishes all k spectral exponents, not merely the product. Complementary principal minor identity yields least coefficient H_N/M_N, with H_N the L2 norm of monic ellipse planar Chebyshev P_N(z)=(c/2)^N U_N(z/c); the largest coefficient is K_N(0,0). The least polynomial f_t, normalized in outer E, has lower coefficients O(t^(N-j)) by fixed-space norm equivalence. Its rescaled monic limit minimizes the E norm uniquely and hence equals P_N. Symmetry of real Gram matrix and simple limiting roots force eventually real simple roots in tE. Exact rational independently constructed monomial moments confirmed all determinant and Chebyshev orthogonality/norm formulas for axes (3,2),(5,1) and N=1..4. This finite check corroborates but does not prove arbitrary N; the fixed-degree exterior-power and minimization proofs do.
